style_cards.name: Proof Escalation Editorial
key_patterns: proof escalation: existence → breadth → process → output → authority

logo-reveal-split.description: Logo animation top + presenter bottom, hook only
logo-reveal-split.caption: standard

proof-overlay-split.description: Proof screenshot dominates top 60-65%, presenter head peeks from bottom 35%
proof-overlay-split.caption: standard at boundary

card-carousel.description: Rapid dark cards cycling, one visible at a time, no avatar
card-carousel.caption: suppressed

demo-fullscreen.description: Full-screen UI recording with cursor, no avatar, no caption
demo-fullscreen.caption: suppressed

avatar-overlay.description: Presenter full-screen with floating overlays ON body (icons, badges, cards)
avatar-overlay.caption: standard or replaced by overlay

proof-fullscreen-warm.description: Output proof screenshot on warm beige background, no avatar
proof-fullscreen-warm.caption: section-label + standard

text-fullscreen-dark.description: Document text on dark background, scrolling, no avatar
text-fullscreen-dark.caption: standard over text

avatar-direct.description: Clean presenter full-screen, no overlays, caption only
avatar-direct.caption: standard

pipeline.step_2_annotate: Open skeleton.json, view frames/, classify each segment (template, visual, caption, proof_class, avatar)
pipeline.step_3_caption_ocr: Manually transcribe captions from keyframes or use OCR if Tesseract is available
pipeline.step_4_style_card: If this reel represents a new style, define the style_card with template_registry and rules
pipeline.step_5_validate: Check all TODO fields are filled, all segments have templates, proof_escalation is ordered
